verdict.rationale: Continuous watchlist re-screening is a fair question for a KYC and identity-verification product, so the axis applies. The pack, however, documents only one-off verification sessions. Webhooks fire on session status changes, and the document blocklist blocks future verifications. Neither is ongoing re-screening of previously verified users against watchlist updates, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on
